content.title: IPL 2026 GT vs KKR Highlights: Shubman Gill, Kagiso Rabada Shine In GTs' 5-Wicket Win Over KKR
content.text: Shubman Gill shone with an 86 off 50 balls as Gujarat Titans defeated Kolkata Knight Riders by five wickets in their IPL 2026 game in Ahmedabad on Friday. The GT captain smashed eight fours and four sixes as his side reached home in 19.4 overs in the chase of 181. Earlier, KKR all-rounder Cameron Green found form, smashing a quick-fire 79 to rescue his side to 180 all out. Green's knock off 55 balls came after KKR saw their top order torn apart by pacers Kagiso Rabada (3/29) and Mohammed Siraj (2/23).
